FGA_AMMO.Card.Title: Ammo Fired - Retrieve?
FGA_AMMO.Notify.NoGM: A GM must be online to roll for ammo.
FGA_AMMO.Settings.Mode.Name: Retrieval Method (GM only)
FGA_AMMO.Settings.Mode.Hint: Die rolls: one d20 per piece of ammo. 5e rules: get back half of what was fired, rounded down.
FGA_AMMO.Settings.Target.Name: Retrieval Target Number
FGA_AMMO.Settings.Target.Hint: Each piece of ammo gets one d20. A roll at or above this number gets it back.
